title: Expense Tracker
description: Build an expense tracker that adds expenses, displays them in a list, calculates totals, filters by category, and saves data to localStorage.

steps.title: Add an expense
steps.description: Write an `addExpense` function that takes `description`, `amount`, and `category`, creates an expense object with a unique id and date, and adds it to the expenses array. Log the new expense.
hints: Expense object: { id: Date.now(), description: '...', amount: 25, category: 'Food', date: new Date().toISOString() }
Use Date.now() for a unique id
Push the expense to the array and log it

verification.successMessage: Expenses can be added with all required fields!
verification.failureMessage: addExpense should create an expense object with id, description, amount, category, and date, then add it to the array.

steps.title: Display the expense list
steps.description: Write a `renderExpenses` function that loops through the expenses array and logs each one as a formatted string: `"$15.00 - Lunch [Food]"`.
hints: Format amount to 2 decimal places: amount.toFixed(2)
Loop through each expense with forEach

verification.successMessage: All expenses render with formatted amounts, descriptions, and categories!
verification.failureMessage: renderExpenses should log each expense as '$X.XX - Description [Category]'.

steps.title: Calculate the total
steps.description: Write a `calcTotal` function that uses `.reduce()` to sum all expense amounts and logs the total formatted with `toFixed(2)`.
hints: Use .toFixed(2) to format to 2 decimal places

verification.successMessage: Total calculation works! Lunch, Bus fare, and Coffee add up to $22.00.
verification.failureMessage: calcTotal should use reduce to sum amounts and log 'Total: $22.00'.

steps.title: Filter expenses by category
steps.description: Write a `filterByCategory` function that takes a category string, filters the expenses array, and logs only matching expenses.
hints: Pass the filtered array to renderExpenses or log it directly

verification.successMessage: Category filtering works! Only 'Food' expenses are shown.
verification.failureMessage: filterByCategory('Food') should show Lunch and Coffee but not Bus fare or Movie.

steps.title: Save and load from localStorage
steps.description: Write `saveExpenses` and `loadExpenses` functions. `saveExpenses` serializes the array to JSON and stores it in localStorage. `loadExpenses` retrieves and parses it. Log the loaded data.
hints: Handle the case where nothing is saved: return an empty array

verification.successMessage: Data persistence works! Expenses saved to localStorage and loaded back.
verification.failureMessage: saveExpenses should store JSON in localStorage, loadExpenses should retrieve it and log the loaded array.
